tagline: Find it, finance it, insure it, all in one place.
illustrativeDisclaimer: Illustrative figures. Final terms depend on approval and Shari'a-approved contracts.
applyInstantly: Apply, get a virtual card instantly
errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
dealerChooseSubtitle: ⚠️ Sandbox sign-in: no password needed. Production uses BCFC partner sign-in with staff roles.
dealerSandboxBanner: ⚠️ Sandbox portal: demo stock and leads, no real customer data.
dealerScanNote: ⚠️ In production the portal scans the customer's QR code with the device camera. In the sandbox, type the code shown in their app.
dealerTokenNotFound: Code not recognised. Ask the customer to share again.
dealerTokenExpired: This code has expired. Ask the customer to share again.
dealerSharedOnly: Shared with the customer's consent: first name and limits only. No salary, CPR or obligations.
dealerOverFinance: Financed amount is above the limit
dealerOfferNote: ⚠️ Sandbox: in production the offer goes to the customer's app to accept.
dealerShareButton: Share my pre-approval with a dealer
dealerShareHint: The dealer sees only your first name, car finance limit and max monthly. Never your salary or CPR.
dealerShareCode: Show this code to the dealer
onboardingIntro: Log in with eKey, tell us your salary and see your limits in about 3 minutes.
cprHint: 9 digits, as on your ID card
ekeySandboxNote: Sandbox: no real eKey login. Any 9-digit CPR returns a demo identity.
salaryInvalid: Enter your monthly salary in BHD.
obligationsHint: Loans, cards and other finance. Enter 0 if none.
obligationsInvalid: Enter an amount in BHD (0 or more).
consentIntro: To give you real limits, we need your permission for two checks. You can withdraw it at any time.
consentCrbBody: We check your existing loans and repayments with the Bahrain Credit Reference Bureau.
consentObBody: We read your salary credits from your bank account (read-only). We can't move your money.
consentExpiry: Your consent lasts {days} days, then expires automatically.
consentRequired: Please give both consents to continue.
consentSandboxNote: Sandbox: no CRB or Open Banking data is actually pulled.
noHeadroom: Your current repayments use up your monthly budget, so we can't offer new finance right now.
cardEligibilityDone: Your eligibility check is already done from your pre-approval.
cardApproved: Approved! Your virtual card is ready
walletOnPhone: Adding a card to your wallet happens on your phone. Open the Sahel app and tap Add to Wallet.
cardSandboxNote: Sandbox: no real card is issued. Only the last 4 digits are shown; the full number and CVV are never sent.
cardDeclined: We can't approve this card right now
declineBelowMinSalary: Your salary is below this card's minimum.
declineNoDbrHeadroom: Your current repayments leave no room for a new credit limit.
applyConsent: By applying, you agree to a credit bureau check. Sandbox: no real check is made.
decisionApprovedBody: Good news: your application is approved. Review your offer below.
decisionReferredBody: A credit officer will review your application and update you here.
decisionDeclinedBody: We can't offer this finance right now.
reasonOk: The monthly payment fits within your borrowing room and your pre-approved limit.
reasonDbrExceeded: The monthly payment of {monthly} is more than the {max} you can add under the {cap}% debt-burden limit.
reasonAmountAbovePreapproval: The amount financed, {amount}, is above your pre-approved limit of {limit}.
reasonHighDbrUtilisation: The monthly payment of {monthly} uses most of the {max} you can still add each month, so a person will check it.
tryLowerAmount: Try a bigger down payment, a longer tenure or a lower amount.
statusAssetPurchased: BCFC buys the asset from the seller
statusOwnershipTransferred: BCFC takes ownership of the asset
statusSaleToCustomer: BCFC sells the asset to you at the Murabaha sale price
murabahaSequenceNote: Shari'a requirement: BCFC must own the asset before selling it to you, so these steps always happen in this order.
personalFinanceSubtitle: For anything you need, Islamic or conventional.
lifeEventsIntro: Tell us what's happening and we'll put together what you need, priced for you and checked against your budget.
lifeEntrySubtitle: Getting married, a new job, a first home or a new baby: see a bundle and whether it fits your budget.
lifeRulesNote: Curated by BCFC product rules, not AI.
lifeOtherMonthly: Plus cover premiums, not counted in DBR: {amount}/month
lifeIllustrative: ⚠️ Illustrative bundle: products, prices and premiums are demo values, not an offer. Final terms depend on a full application.
settleFeeNote: ⚠️ Placeholder fee pending CBB rules. Figures are as of your last paid installment.
settleIbraNote: ⚠️ Ibra' is a discretionary rebate on profit not yet earned. Placeholder rule pending BCFC's Shari'a Supervisory Board and CBB rules.
settleAutopayHint: Pay each installment automatically on its due date (sandbox).
insHubSubtitle: Compare insurers side by side. Tasheelat Insurance is a broker, so you see quotes from several insurers.
insMotorBody: Comprehensive or third party, for the car in your garage
insTravelBody: Single trips of up to 180 days, for the whole family
insHomeBody: Building and contents, for one year
insPolicyBindFailed: Payment received, but the policy could not be issued yet. Our team will contact you.
insSandboxNote: ⚠️ Sandbox: demo insurers and illustrative prices.
insErrorDates: Check the dates: the trip must start today or later (within a year) and end on or after the start.
insErrorTripTooLong: A single trip can be at most 180 days.
insErrorTravellers: Check the travellers: 1 to 6 adults and up to 8 children.
insErrorSumInsured: Check the sums insured: building 0 or BHD 10,000 to 2,000,000; contents 0 or BHD 1,000 to 250,000; not both 0.
insErrorNotInsurable: Land can't be insured under home cover.
noCardsYet: No cards yet. Apply in minutes from Cards.
sessionSandboxNote: Sandbox: your profile is kept for this session only, until eKey login is live.
boSandboxBanner: ⚠️ Sandbox: no staff login, anyone can pick a role. Actions go to an in-memory audit log and no money moves.
boChooseRoleSubtitle: Pick a role. Staff single sign-on replaces this before production.
boRoleCreditOfficerDesc: Reviews referred finance applications and approves or declines them.
boRoleOperationsDesc: Refunds insurance premiums that never became a policy. Sees payment data only.
boRoleComplianceDesc: Read-only: the queues and the audit log, without salary or obligations.
boForbidden: Your role cannot open this page.
boCreditSubtitle: Oldest first, from every customer. Approve or decline with a note: the note is internal and goes to the audit log.
boNoteRequired: Write a note of at least 5 characters.
boDecidedApproved: Approved. The customer now sees the offer and can accept it.
boDecidedDeclined: Declined. The customer sees the decision.
boRefundsSubtitle: Captured insurance premiums that never became a policy (quote expired, paid twice, or never confirmed). Oldest first.
boAuditSubtitle: Every back-office action: who, role, when and note. Newest first, read-only.
boReviewedApprovedBody: A credit officer reviewed your application and approved it. You can accept the offer.
boReviewedDeclinedBody: A credit officer reviewed your application and could not approve it this time.
aiGreetingSuhail: Hi! I'm Suhail, your BCFC assistant. Ask me about your installments, early settlement, cars within your budget, insurance or cards, in English or Arabic.
aiGreetingSuhaila: Hi! I'm Suhaila, your BCFC assistant. Ask me about your installments, early settlement, cars within your budget, insurance or cards, in English or Arabic.
aiSuggestBalance: How much do I still owe on the car?
aiSuggestCars: Find me an SUV under BHD 200 a month
aiConfirmNote: Suhail and Suhaila never pay, sign or apply for you: an action opens the usual screen, where you review and confirm.
aiSandboxNote: Sandbox: a rules-based assistant (no AI model yet) that reads only your own session data.
aiErrorRateLimit: Too many messages. Wait a moment and try again.
aiErrorTooLong: That message is too long. Please keep it shorter.
aiErrorGeneric: Sorry, I couldn't answer just now. Please try again.
aiEntryBody: Your balance, next installment or a car within budget, in seconds.
homeStatusValuationConfirmed: TRESCO valuation of the property confirmed
homeStatusLeaseStarted: Lease starts: you live in the home and pay monthly rentals
homeStatusOwnershipToCustomer: Ownership transfers to you after the final rental
homeIjaraSequenceNote: Shari'a requirement: BCFC must own the home before leasing it to you, and ownership passes to you only after the final rental.
homeValuationPending: Next step: TRESCO values the property before BCFC pays the seller. Pay the valuation fee to continue.
homeValuationPaid: Valuation fee received. Continue to confirm the valuation and pay the seller.
homeLeaseActive: Your Ijara lease is active. The home becomes yours after the final rental.
bindServerAmount: Amount set by BCFC for this request
tradeIntro: Tell us about your car and get an instant offer you can use as your down payment.
tradeSandboxNote: Sandbox: the valuation is a deterministic rules model, not AI. Prices are illustrative.
tradeAccident: The car has been in an accident
tradePlateHint: 1 to 6 digits. We only ever show the last 2.
tradeEntryCars: Have a car to trade in? Get an instant offer
tradeCapped: Your offer is above the maximum down payment, so {amount} is used.
tradeTopUp: Add {amount} in cash to reach the minimum down payment.
tradeCreditNote: The trade-in is credited at delivery (sandbox).
tradeErrorGeneric: We couldn't value this car. Please check the details.
tradeErrorMileage: Enter the mileage in km, from 0 to {max}.
tradeErrorPlate: The plate must be 1 to 6 digits.
claimNewSubtitle: Tell us what happened. It takes a few minutes, and Tasheelat Insurance passes it to your insurer.
claimNoMotorPolicy: You have no active motor policy to claim on. Get motor cover first.
claimIncidentAt: Date and time of the incident
claimLocationPlaceholder: e.g. Sheikh Khalifa Highway, near Isa Town
claimLocationUnavailable: Location unavailable. Describe the place instead.
claimThirdParty: Another vehicle or person was involved
claimPhotosHint: Up to {max} photos (JPEG, PNG or WebP). They are made smaller on your device before upload.
claimPhotosSandboxNote: Sandbox: photos are checked, then discarded. Only their type and size are kept.
claimErrorFuture: The incident time cannot be in the future.
claimErrorOutsidePolicy: The incident must be within your policy period.
claimErrorTooOld: This incident is too old to report in the app. Please call us.
claimErrorTime: Check the date and time of the incident.
claimErrorPoliceReport: Enter a valid police report number.
claimErrorPhotosRequired: Add at least one photo of the damage.
claimErrorPhoto: A photo cannot be used. Use JPEG, PNG or WebP within the size limit.
claimErrorNotCovered: Third-party cover only pays for damage to someone else.
claimErrorDescription: Describe what happened in a little more detail.
claimErrorPolicy: This policy cannot be used for a claim.
claimEstimateNotAi: Sandbox placeholder: a fixed table by type and severity, not an AI estimate. Your insurer's assessor decides.
claimEstimateTotalLoss: Total loss: settled at the insured value of the car.
claimGarageAfterApproval: You can choose a garage once the claim is approved.
claimGarageAgencyHint: Agency garages are listed because your policy includes agency repair.
claimReplacementBody: {provider} can give you a {vehicleClass} for up to {days} days while your car is off the road.
claimReplacementNote: Information only: booking in the app is not available yet.
claimSandboxAdvanceNote: Sandbox only: these buttons stand in for the insurer's claims team.
claimSandboxNote: Sandbox: claims are kept in memory and are not sent to any insurer.
notifEmpty: You're all caught up. Reminders about payments, renewals and applications appear here.
notifWouldSend: Sandbox: would also send by {channels}. Nothing is sent.
notifInAppOnly: In the app only (every channel is off for this kind of update).
notifSandboxNote: Sandbox: reminders are worked out from your account each time you look. Nothing is sent outside the app.
notifPrefsIntro: Choose how we reach you for each kind of update. Your inbox in the app always shows everything.
notifPrefsMandatory: Required: keep at least one channel on (consumer protection).
notifPrefsQuietHoursHint: No push, SMS, WhatsApp or email between these times (Bahrain time). Messages wait until the end.
notifPrefsErrorMandatory: Overdue payment notices need at least one channel.
notifPrefsSandboxNote: Sandbox: nothing is sent by push, SMS, WhatsApp or email. Your choices are kept in memory only.
notifInstallmentDueBody: {amount} for {contract}. Pay now from My installments.
notifInstallmentDueAutopayBody: {amount} for {contract} will be collected by autopay.
notifInstallmentOverdueBody: {amount} for {contract} was due on {date}. Please pay as soon as you can.
notifAutopayOffBody: Turn on autopay for {contract} so the {amount} due on {date} is paid on time.
notifSettlementCompletedBody: {contract} was settled on {date}. Nothing more is due.
notifRegistrationExpiringBody: Renew the registration of your {vehicle} in time.
notifRegistrationExpiredBody: The registration of your {vehicle} ended on {date}. Renew it before you drive.
notifGarageInsuranceExpiringBody: Compare quotes and renew cover for your {vehicle}.
notifGarageInsuranceExpiredBody: Cover for your {vehicle} ended on {date}. Get a quote to stay covered.
notifPolicyExpiringBody: Policy {number} with {insurer}. Compare quotes to renew in time.
notifPolicyExpiringTravelBody: Policy {number} with {insurer}. Staying longer? Get new cover before it ends.
notifClaimUnderAssessmentBody: The assessor is reviewing your claim and photos.
notifClaimApprovedBody: Open the claim for the approved amount and your next step.
notifClaimRejectedBody: Open the claim to see the decision.
notifApplicationApprovedBody: Review and accept your offer: {monthly} a month.
notifApplicationReferredTitle: Your application is with a credit officer
notifApplicationReferredBody: We'll let you know as soon as it is decided.
notifApplicationDeclinedBody: Open it to see why and what you can do next.
notifApplicationValuationFeeBody: Your {product} finance waits for the TRESCO valuation fee.
notifApplicationValuationPaidBody: The valuation fee is paid. Continue to finish your finance.
notifApplicationLeaseStartedBody: BCFC bought the home and leased it to you: {monthly} a month.
notifApplicationCompletedBody: Every step is done. Installments: {monthly} a month.
notifCardIssuedBody: Your virtual card ending {last4} is active.
notifTradeInExpiringBody: Use your {amount} offer for the {vehicle} before it expires.
notifPreApprovalExpiringBody: Refresh it in a minute to keep your limits.
notifPreApprovalExpiredBody: It ended on {date}. Refresh it to see your limits again.
notifConsentExpiringBody: Renew your CRB and Open Banking consent to keep your pre-approval up to date.
notifConsentExpiredBody: It ended on {date}. Renew it to refresh your pre-approval.
